_comment: Every fixture is a registry tag pinned by sha256 (registry/v1.json is the source of truth for tag->file->sha). A missing or mismatched fixture FAILS the gate; it is never 'blocked'. Prompts are committed files; run.py records their md5 alongside every result.

load.why: Loader / daemon / runtime load path / arch load changed. Each fixture must load through the user route (hipfire run) and produce attractor-free decoded text.

fixtures.why: Canonical dense trunk (AGENTS.md pinned fixture); Qwen3.5-family text artifact whose embedded config carries vision_config with no vision tower.
MoE A3B (arch 6) — router/expert load path and the MQ4V2 MoE gate routing from PR #664.
LFM2 (arch 11) — the second family with a config-vs-tower vision classifier; small and fast.
MQ4V2 xt tier — the neutral-header v2 quant family (537a292df) that the device-mesh series refused.

serve.why: Engine / generate / daemon serve semantics changed. serve_harness proves visible serving semantics (battery = varied prompts, chain = related turns) on the dense trunk.

kernel.why: kernels/ / rdna-compute / hipfire-dispatch / hip-bridge changed. docs/VALIDATION.md route: redline_daemon_harness capture + multi-position HIP/PM4 parity.
